relics.effect: All allied units have +20% HP
relics.flavor: 'After fermentation, the body fluids of this Originium slug can be used to stop bleeding.' —'Rhodes Island Wilderness Survival Guide'

relics.name: First Aid Kit
relics.effect: All allied units have +35% HP
relics.flavor: '...Please use antibiotics and ethanol additives under the supervision of professionals...' —Rim Billiton Production Safety Manual
relics.unlock: Select 'Tactical Fortification Squad' and complete your adventure

relics.name: Unknown Instrument
relics.effect: All allied units have +50% HP
relics.flavor: Don't ask. It's for your own good.

relics.name: Rusted Razor
relics.effect: All enemies take +15% Physical damage
relics.flavor: If you cut yourself with this, you know what will happen.

relics.name: Carriage Driver's Whip
relics.effect: All enemies take +25% Physical damage
relics.flavor: As the troupe's carriage driver, he has no name and no past. His life is meaningful only when he whips his burdenbeasts.
relics.unlock: Select 'Tactical Ranged Squad' and complete your adventure

relics.name: 'Hateful Avenger'
relics.effect: All enemies take +35% Physical damage
relics.flavor: A gift from Theresis and set up by Theresa, this is the very first weapon that Ascalon received after her inaugural mission as part of the Military Council.

relics.name: Standard Anti-Riot Instrument
relics.effect: All enemies take +20% Arts damage
relics.flavor: Standard equipment of the Ursus Guard. Comes with an intermittent blinding Originium Arts effect. Unfortunately, not many Guards out there remember this when push comes to shove.

relics.name: Emperor's Collection
relics.effect: All enemies take +30% Arts damage
relics.flavor: The Sami revere their wild lands more than anything, and this fragment of the vast wilderness sleeps in the personal collection of the Emperor of Ursus.
relics.unlock: Select 'Tactical Destruction Squad' and complete your adventure

relics.name: 'Brilliant Lament'
relics.effect: All enemies take +40% Arts damage
relics.flavor: His blood yet flows. He has never left this place.

relics.name: Live Rose
relics.effect: All allied units have +20% healing effectiveness
relics.flavor: Is it you who nourishes her, or is it her who protects you?

relics.name: White Flower Crown
relics.effect: All allied units have +30% healing effectiveness
relics.flavor: A floral veil used in Vampire rituals. Its once vibrant redness has been sucked empty, leaving only a pale white color.

relics.name: Actor's Perfume
relics.effect: All allied units recover 1% of Max HP per second
relics.flavor: Troupe actors put this on before going onstage. Stable yet aromatic fragrances like this can help them ease pressure. That's how it seems on the surface, at least.

relics.name: Designer's Ruler
relics.effect: All allied units have +15% Physical Dodge
relics.flavor: Carefully measured with data and experience, those who wear this armor are known to be several magnitudes luckier.

relics.name: 'Arts Killer'
relics.effect: All allied units have +15% Arts Dodge
relics.flavor: Considering how Originium Arts and music go hand in hand in Leithanien, it's quite amazing someone came up with the bright idea of combating Arts with noise like this.

relics.name: Dancer's Bracelets
relics.effect: All allied units have +10% Physical and Arts Dodge
relics.flavor: The audience breaks into applause as the well-trained dancers waltz around the traps on stage. None of them are aware of the brushes with death the performers have just been through.
relics.unlock: Clear the 4th Floor, 'Probable Divergence'

relics.name: Doll House
relics.effect: Starting DP +10
relics.flavor: Every kid needs at least one set.

relics.name: Miniature Stage Model
relics.effect: Starting DP +20
relics.flavor: The red paint has not yet dried. Careful. Don't get that paint on your hand.

relics.name: Dreambind Castle Model
relics.effect: Starting DP +30
relics.flavor: You've seen this place, and you once wandered the castle, yet you now hold it in your hand. Is this real, or is it all a dream?
relics.unlock: Clear the 2nd Floor, 'Wrought Ironroots'

relics.name: Jet-Black Dance Shoes
relics.effect: Can deploy Melee Operators on High Ground tiles
relics.flavor: The Columbian dancer's steps are firm and strong, her taps reverberating loudly in the air as she strikes the ground.
relics.unlock: Clear the 3rd Floor, 'Ashforged Ruins' a total of 3 times, with 6 or more Ranged or Melee Operators recruited

relics.name: Pure White Dance Shoes
relics.effect: Can deploy Ranged Operators on Low Ground tiles
relics.flavor: The Ursus dancer's steps are swift and elegant, her body moving as she wills.
relics.unlock: Clear the 3rd Floor, 'Ashforged Ruins' a total of 3 times, with 6 or more Ranged or Melee Operators recruited

relics.name: Ancient Gaulish Silver Coin
relics.effect: All Operators start with +6 SP
relics.flavor: A coin once circulated in the now fallen nation of 'Gaul.' It is in very good shape, making it highly valuable as a collector's item.

relics.name: Bank of Gaul Check
relics.effect: All Operators start with +12 SP
relics.flavor: An extravagant checkbook plated in gold and silver. Can no longer be cashed.

relics.name: 'Second Economic Reform Act'
relics.effect: All Operators start with +18 SP
relics.flavor: With this bill as the starting point, Gaul formally began its path to become a hegemonic empire.

relics.name: Vanilla Soda
relics.effect: Increases the SP regen rate of Auto Recovery skills by +0.2/s
relics.flavor: Bolívar's cheap specialty drink dates back hundreds of years. It is mixed with a variety of spices, and is known for not being very good.

relics.name: Fowlbeast Liver Pate
relics.effect: Increases the SP regen rate of Auto Recovery skills by +0.35/s
relics.flavor: A small jar of fowlbeast liver pâté. Bright and vividly colorful, it is eaten only by nobles.

relics.name: Dreaming Essence
relics.effect: Increases the SP regen rate of Auto Recovery skills by +0.5/s
relics.flavor: Supposedly the Banshees make their aromatics only for their beloved. A single drop is enough to enchant just about anyone, bringing out any artist's inspiration and creativity.

relics.name: Captain Morgan's Wine
relics.effect: Increases the SP regen rate of Offensive and Defensive Recovery skills by 1 SP per 3s
relics.flavor: A wine produced in the Iberian region. Despite having gained popularity in the heart of Victoria's bustling cities, it is now discontinued.

relics.name: Water of Life
relics.effect: Increases the SP regen rate of Offensive and Defensive Recovery skills by 1 SP per 2.5s
relics.flavor: The strongest Ursus liquors go straight to one's head, but it's said that the healthy Ursusian adult can down several bottles.
relics.unlock: Select 'First-Class Squad' and complete your adventure

relics.name: Royal Liqueur
relics.effect: Increases the SP regen rate of Offensive and Defensive Recovery skills by 1 SP per 1.5s
relics.flavor: The fine wines of the fallen nation of Gaul have now become prized treasures for collectors. The place of production has moved to Leithanien, but the technique has been lost.

relics.name: String Puppet
relics.effect: Enemies receive 700 Arts damage per second when stunned, frozen, or bound
relics.flavor: The more you struggle and try to break free, the tighter the strings get. Do you really think you are still thinking rationally?

relics.name: 'Children's Puppet'
relics.effect: Enemies receive 1000 Arts damage per second when stunned, frozen, or bound
relics.flavor: A simple puppet made by Iberian children using trinkets found on the seacoast. Supposedly just holding it tight will give you much richer dreams.

relics.name: Victory Horn
relics.effect: Increases the duration of single-instance status effects such as stun, cold, or freeze by 100%
relics.flavor: Blow the horn, cry out, and scatter our foes with its roar!

relics.name: Flash Camera
relics.effect: Increases the duration of single-instance status effects such as stun, cold, or freeze by 110%
relics.flavor: Every photo shot by this camera is washed out in white, with only the victim's twisted expression faintly visible.
relics.unlock: Complete an adventure while having at least 3 Supporter Operators

relics.name: Therapy Tape
relics.effect: Increases the duration of single-instance status effects such as stun, cold, or freeze by 150%
relics.flavor: He tried to stop you from listening. He said it was dangerous. He said you should not stay. Do you understand now? You are listening to his song.

relics.name: Old Fan
relics.effect: All Operators gain +10% ATK for every different type of Operator class in the squad
relics.flavor: When it rains for several days on end, the old Yanese Tianshi complains to his friends about the pain in his knees, before casually waving his fan and driving away the rainclouds. It is about time he taught this trick to his young apprentice, currently working at the Central Judicial Office.
relics.unlock: Complete an adventure while having at least 20 Operators

relics.name: Scout's Scope
relics.effect: Enemies take increased damage from allied units as range increases (max 100%)
relics.flavor: Lock on, aim, fire, and destroy the enemy's will to resist, all in the name of a better future that Scout will never see. Maybe you can do it for him.
relics.unlock: Complete an adventure while having at least 3 Sniper Operators

relics.name: Black Tulip
relics.effect: Allied Operators gradually gain ATK when not using a skill, up to a maximum of +60% after 60 seconds; bonus is reset when skill ends
relics.flavor: Silence crushed the Iberians, so she knows she must speak up. If her words aren't sharp enough, her sword will speak for her.

relics.name: Spinach Pack
relics.effect: Operators have +60% ATK for one second after their skill becomes active
relics.flavor: Many Cautus out there believe that popping the contents of this can into their mouths will grant them immense strength. The marketing's effectiveness is a classic success story in the industry.

relics.name: Wrath of Siracusans
relics.effect: Operators have +100% ATK for one second after their skill becomes active
relics.flavor: The signature pasta dish of an 'authentic Siracusan restaurant' that once operated in the capital of Gaul. The dish's unique taste, and particularly its sauce—a blend of thick chocolate sauce and Originium Slug liver—earned the praise of many Gaulish nobles. Supposedly, though, this dish nearly caused a diplomatic crisis between Siracusa and Gaul.
relics.unlock: Clear [Failed Dare] without losing more than 3 Life Points

relics.name: Castle's Offspring
relics.effect: All Operators gain +300 DEF and +30 RES after being deployed for 100 seconds
relics.flavor: With enough time, this box will become a whole new stage.
relics.unlock: Complete an adventure with at least 80 Operators deployed in battle

relics.name: 'Glorious Kazimierz'
relics.effect: Operators have +70% ATK for 6 seconds after dodging
relics.flavor: A Kazimierzian best-seller that adapts the deeds of the arena's brightest-shining knights into a novel. Nearl, who was exiled but returned to reclaim her laurels, occupies a considerable portion of its pages.

relics.name: 'The Return'
relics.effect: Operators have +130% ATK for 6 seconds after dodging
relics.flavor: This Kazimierzian best-seller is said to be a collective creation by fans. 'Nearl' has already become an amalgamation of many ideals and fantasies. 'For her, exile was not an escape. She came back, and stood alone against the era's torrents.'
relics.unlock: Across multiple adventures, clear a total of 40 battles

relics.name: Lakebed Aegis
relics.effect: Shield +1; all allied units gain Max HP +60% if you have any Shield at the start of a battle
relics.flavor: Three decades ago, a child dropped his toy wooden shield into the lake. Three decades later, he bores through the frozen lake, retrieves his shield, and embarks on a hero's journey.
relics.unlock: Across multiple adventures, enter a total of 40 non-combat nodes

relics.name: Empty Fowlbeast
relics.effect: Summons have +30% HP, +30% ATK, and when on the field, grant +60% ATK to their summoners
relics.flavor: The body is long since gone, but the soul remains in the shell for eternity. The unmelting creatures in the branches and leaves carry icicles as they spread their wings in the forest.

relics.name: Living Woodplate
relics.effect: All allied melee units gain a Barrier equal to 50% of their Max HP on deployment
relics.flavor: Shamans know the formidable will to survive that trees possess, so when a warrior has a similar will, they invite the trees to be their armor.
relics.unlock: Win a battle while having at least 3 Defender Operators

relics.name: Rock Horn
relics.effect: An Operator gains ATK +20% for every Operator in the adjacent 4 tiles
relics.flavor: If you want to gather up manpower in Sami, blowing a trumpet is definitely the best way to do it.

relics.name: Ribbon of Honor
relics.effect: All allied units have +100% ATK when blocking only one enemy
relics.flavor: Numerous actors have played this character, yet none of them were able to save the character's dearest friend.

relics.name: Chitinous Ripper
relics.effect: When a battle begins, a random Operator will have +100% ATK and +100% HP for that battle
relics.flavor: A more efficient way of growing an exoskeleton. It can tear prey apart, resist impact, and also be turned into a delicacy for its kin.

relics.name: Medicine Sticks
relics.effect: All allied units gain 2 layers of Shield when deployed
relics.flavor: Inspired by ancient Yanese soldiers who marched with something in their mouths to maintain silence, Mulberry created this edible hard plaster. Excellent for prolonged chewing and spirit lifting.

relics.name: Convalescence Access Card
relics.effect: Operators gain +40 ASPD for 10 seconds after deployment
relics.flavor: A special service from the Convalescent Garden! Each Operator is entitled to one physiotherapy session from the Convalescent Garden before each of their field operations. Non-transferrable.

relics.name: Convalescence Premium Card
relics.effect: Operators gain +70 ASPD for 10 seconds after deployment
relics.flavor: A special collaboration between Convalescent Garden and the Medical Department! Each Operator receives a comprehensive physical and psychological assessment, plus a physiotherapy session. Afterwards, they can enjoy Podenco's homemade flower cakes.

relics.name: Old George's Nutri-Paste
relics.effect: Operators gain ATK as their HP increases, up to +30% ATK at 100% HP
relics.flavor: This poor-tasting fortified nutritional supplement was originally a 'dietary supplement' periodically provided to Columbian Pioneers, but after extensive marketing, it suddenly became a 'beauty product' beloved by nobles.
relics.unlock: Select 'Improvisation Squad' and complete your adventure

relics.name: Emergency Stimulant
relics.effect: Operators gain ASPD as their HP decreases, up to +60 ASPD at 30% HP
relics.flavor: An injection commonly used in Rim Billiton's local mines. Its strong active ingredient can stimulate the workers' senses and ensure their work efficiency in extreme environments. When life and their project both present their deadlines, sometimes the choice is simpler than one might think.

relics.name: Timeworn Poetry Strips
relics.effect: Summons have +30% HP, +30% ATK, and will no longer use Deployment slots
relics.flavor: 'Drunk far beyond all mounts that list the realm, all beings take on souls as they demand.'

relics.name: Familiar Sculpture
relics.effect: All enemy units have -15 ASPD
relics.flavor: A familiar face but a different vibe. Perhaps you have met this person?

relics.name: 'Painful Happiness'
relics.effect: All enemy units have -15% HP and Movement Speed
relics.flavor: Oripathy is spreading among the troupe members. Some collapsed, some broke out crying, some were overjoyed, and some turned their attention to writing. It was at such a time that the young man received his coming-of-age present. He will sing his very last song as an actor.

relics.name: Dawn of Literature
relics.effect: Deals 50% more physical and Arts damage to [Sarkaz] enemies
relics.flavor: 'Aqqam Naqqun Sarqqam. That is 'Amnannam', the one and only curse, the uttering that kills even those who have yet to hear it. Now weep!'

relics.name: Gravity Defying Machine
relics.effect: All enemies have -2 Weight
relics.flavor: Nasti Lunorey's magnum opus lifted the Sarkaz from the land that had tormented them for thousands of years. Now, though they float in ethereal clouds, they remain firmly rooted in the sky.

relics.name: Halo
relics.effect: All [Sarkaz] enemies have -30% Movement Speed
relics.flavor: 'When I entered that door, my elder brother had already sprouted a halo and wings of light. As he turned around and greeted me, his words were like a key, freeing me from the suffering in my heart. And then, I responded aloud, the halo completely connected, and I received my revelation.'

relics.name: Blunt Claws - Advancement
relics.effect: Vanguard Operators have -2 DP Cost and +60% HP
relics.flavor: Plant a great stone within the waters. Split the waves and part the fog.

relics.name: Blunt Claws - Burst
relics.effect: Vanguard Operators start with +15 SP
relics.flavor: He's already done all the reserve squad's work for them. What else do you expect?

relics.name: Blunt Claws - Proficiency
relics.effect: The SP Cost of Vanguard Operators' skills is decreased by 35%
relics.flavor: As operators who are often the first to head into battle, what they have been through is unfathomable.

relics.name: Blunt Claws - Mastery
relics.effect: Vanguard Operators have +50% ATK and DEF
relics.flavor: 'When the darkly-clad enemies rushed towards me, there were only four words on my mind — they are done for.'

relics.name: Bend Spears - Advancement
relics.effect: Guard Operators have -3 DP Cost and +40% HP
relics.flavor: The soldiers stepped onto the battlefield, drew their blades, and met in battle.

relics.name: Bend Spears - Acuity
relics.effect: Guard Operators have +25% ATK
relics.flavor: 'This is the 7th blade you've broken this month.' 'But I cut down eight enemies this month.'

relics.name: Bend Spears - Bloodbath
relics.effect: Guard Operators restore 2 SP after each attack
relics.flavor: Soldiers who get bolder as time passes are rare. Most need some form of psychological counseling to alleviate the trauma of war.

relics.name: Bend Spears - Deathmatch
relics.effect: Guard Operators have -40% DEF, but gain +40% ATK and +30 ASPD
relics.flavor: I wouldn't really recommend learning those skills from Blaze.

relics.name: Iron Guard - Advancement
relics.effect: Defender Operators have -3 DP Cost and +40% HP
relics.flavor: The shieldbearers formed a mountain range and became the earth. What they fight against are not enemies of flesh and blood. They fight against fate and injustice.

relics.name: Iron Guard - Invasion
relics.effect: Defender Operators have +60% ATK
relics.flavor: Defensive actions for the sake of teammates or strategic purposes often make people forget about their original aggressiveness.

relics.name: Iron Guard - Consolidation
relics.effect: Defender Operators gain HP +40%, DEF +40%, and RES +20
relics.flavor: No matter how heavy fate's blow is, take it.

relics.name: Iron Guard - Impenetrable
relics.effect: Defender Operators restore 2 SP after being attacked
relics.flavor: Every blow they endure will turn into anger and be returned severalfold.

relics.name: Fatal Bolts - Advancement
relics.effect: Sniper Operators have -2 DP Cost and +60% HP
relics.flavor: Load, aim, and fire. Destruction arrives as scheduled.

relics.name: Fatal Bolts - Precision
relics.effect: Sniper Operators have +20% ATK
relics.flavor: In an era when Originium Arts were not as robust as they are now, Yan had a saying, 'a pierced willow leaf from a hundred paces,' to praise others for their mastery of archery.

relics.name: Fatal Bolts - Crossfire
relics.effect: Sniper Operators have -40% HP, but gain +40% ATK
relics.flavor: The dense crossfire also exposes snipers to great danger. The next battle boils down to a game of vision.

relics.name: Fatal Bolts - Divine Speed
relics.effect: Sniper Operators have +70 ASPD
relics.flavor: It is said that the legendary archers of ancient Victoria could almost shoot a continuous stream of arrows.

relics.name: Broken Wand - Advancement
relics.effect: Caster Operators have -3 DP Cost and +60% HP
relics.flavor: Let Arts dance around your fingertips. Call the wind and rain, unravel reality, and achieve your grand goals.

relics.name: Broken Wand - Arts Weaving
relics.effect: Caster Operators have +25% ATK and +25 ASPD
relics.flavor: Those who gaze up at the great spires of Leithanien often see strange or even celestial phenomena.

relics.name: Broken Wand - Concentration
relics.effect: Increases the SP regen rate of Caster Operators by +0.4/s
relics.flavor: 'When a caster intends to go all out, they will display a completely different temperament — even if we're talking about something like Skyfire's grumpiness.'

relics.name: Broken Wand - Malediction
relics.effect: Caster Operators have -40% HP, but deal +70% Arts damage
relics.flavor: It is virtually impossible to identify when the Sarkaz first encountered Originium, and the origins of these ancient Arts have long been separated from actual reality and common sense.

relics.name: Stalwart Aid - Advancement
relics.effect: Supporter Operators have -2 DP Cost and +60% HP
relics.flavor: Whenever you're 'almost done' with a task, what you need at that moment is someone to help you with the 'almost' part.

relics.name: Stalwart Aid - Diligence
relics.effect: The SP Cost of Supporter Operators' skills is decreased by 40%
relics.flavor: Operators tend to give it their all, even to tasks that might seem trivial. The reality is, those tasks are not trivial at all.

relics.name: Stalwart Aid - Assistance
relics.effect: Allied units within the attack range of Supporter Operators gain +20% ATK
relics.flavor: Proper meals, correct paths, or simply having a heart-to-heart... Victory is won through these little things.

relics.name: Stalwart Aid - Counter-Arts
relics.effect: Enemies within the attack range of Supporter Operators have -20% DEF and -20% RES
relics.flavor: There are many ways to weaken an enemy's defensive capabilities: positional devices, armor-stripping Arts, marking weak points, and... giving them a stomachache.

relics.name: Healer's Path - Advancement
relics.effect: Medic Operators have -2 DP Cost and +60% HP
relics.flavor: The desire to save lives is a virtue that mankind must applaud, for that is the support that keeps us alive.

relics.name: Healer's Path - Self-Treating
relics.effect: Increases the SP regen rate of Medic Operators by +0.3/s
relics.flavor: Who says healers can't heal themselves? They simply pop some pills before continuing to help others.

relics.name: Healer's Path - Keen Hands
relics.effect: Medic Operators gain +50 ASPD
relics.flavor: Compared to snatching a life from the grip of death, what's three days of coma afterward?

relics.name: Healer's Path - Restore Sanity
relics.effect: Allied units within the attack range of Medic Operators gain Resistance
relics.flavor: Making one's body as solid as a nomadic city is a bit of a romanticized description, but our medics are ready to put that idea into practice.

relics.name: Rusted Blade - Advancement
relics.effect: Specialist Operators have -2 DP Cost and +60% HP
relics.flavor: There may be many means, but only one end.

relics.name: Rusted Blade - Execution
relics.effect: Specialist Operators have +30 ASPD
relics.flavor: Endless rust to scrape, and a bottomless list of tasks to complete.

relics.name: Rusted Blade - No Man's Land
relics.effect: The Redeployment Time of Specialist Operators -35%
relics.flavor: A shadow blinks, a faint sound stirs, and a life is taken. The audience is the next victim.

relics.name: Blunt Claws - Predation
relics.effect: For every Vanguard Operator on the field, gain 1 DP every 3 seconds (Stacks up to 8 times)
relics.flavor: The pack rumbles with hunger, waiting for a feast.

relics.name: Bend Spears - Rending
relics.effect: For every Guard Operator on the field, all allied units gain ATK +8% (Stacks up to 8 times)
relics.flavor: Those with power can always help each other to success.

relics.name: Broken Wand - Undulation
relics.effect: For every Caster Operator on the field, all allied units deal +12% Arts damage (Stacks up to 8 times)
relics.flavor: Tuned to the same frequency; together we'll play the melody.

relics.name: Rusted Blade - Protraction
relics.effect: For every Specialist Operator on the field, all enemies have -5% Movement Speed (Stacks up to 8 times)
relics.flavor: If the host does not want guests, they'll never reach the door.

relics.name: Rusted Blade - Lone Force
relics.effect: When there are no allies in the surrounding 4 tiles of a Specialist operator, they gain +70% ATK
relics.flavor: Solitude.

relics.name: Hand of Buckler
relics.effect: Decel Binder, Hexer, and Abjurer Operators' attacks deal extra Arts damage equal to 3% of the target's current HP
relics.flavor: Drop by drop, bit by bit. It is unstoppable.

relics.name: Hand of Predation
relics.effect: Pioneer, Charger, and Tactician Operators gain +10% ATK and DEF on every skill activation (Stacks up to 10 times); If you have Blunt Claws - Predation, also increases their SP regen rate by +0.5/s
relics.flavor: Herds stir, flesh rend asunder.

relics.name: Hand of Rending
relics.effect: Reaper, Soloblade, and Fighter Operators ignore 70% of the target's DEF; If you have Bend Spears - Rending, they also recover 2.5% of Max HP per second
relics.flavor: Mountains shatter, stones devoured.

relics.name: Hand of Undulation
relics.effect: Splash Caster, Chain Caster, and Mech-accord Caster Operators recover 2 SP each time they deal damage to an enemy unit; If you have Broken Wand - Undulation, they also gain +20 ASPD
relics.flavor: Blasts conquer, the wake deafening.

relics.name: Hand of Protraction
relics.effect: Ambusher, Merchant, and Geek Operators gain +25% ATK for every 30 seconds they remain on the battlefield (Stacks up to 5 times); If you have Rusted Blade - Protraction, maximum stack increases to 8
relics.flavor: Protracted battles, a home of carnage.

relics.name: Hand of Mystery
relics.effect: Core Caster, Primal Caster, and Ritualist Operators gain +0.5/s SP recovery rate whenever they use a skill (Stacks up to 4 times)
relics.flavor: Mists part, the truth approaches.

relics.name: Hand of Rumble
relics.effect: Artilleryman, Phalanx Caster, and Flinger Operators gain +15% ATK for every time they deal damage to the same unit, up to 150%; this bonus will reset if no damage is dealt for 5 seconds
relics.flavor: Strikes land true, the earth trembles.

relics.name: Antique Casting
relics.effect: Immediately Promote 3 Operators (Does not require Hope)
relics.flavor: 'Harken, the forge of the sky, awaits five earthborn metals'... Even though it can be used for all kinds of work, nobody understands its exact mechanism.
relics.unlock: Across multiple adventures, promote a total of 35 Operators

relics.name: Rusted Iron Hammer
relics.effect: Shop vendors charge -50% Originium Ingots for their goods
relics.flavor: 'Change is necessary, and we must do all we can to hasten the oncoming storm.'

relics.name: Rhodes Island Tactical Transceiver
relics.effect: Gain an additional choice when Recruitment Vouchers are dropped after battle
relics.flavor: Hang in there, help's on the way.

relics.name: Four-Leaf Clover Fossil
relics.effect: Gain an additional choice when loot drops from a Wish Fulfilled node or after battle
relics.flavor: A symbol of luck that Magallan found in a place all but devoid of life. The rock has no doubt experienced many violent changes of the lands, but it survived, giving those who come across it a small bit of lingering hope.
relics.unlock: Across multiple adventures, obtain 100 Collectibles

relics.name: Three-Dimensional Art Display
relics.effect: Recover 7 Life Points and recover an additional 1 Life Point after each battle
relics.flavor: Rhine Lab is often like this artwork: mysterious, sophisticated, and inscrutable.
relics.unlock: Clear the 1st Floor, 'Furnace Origin'

relics.name: Golden Chalice
relics.effect: For each 5 Originium Ingots in possession, all allied units have +7 ASPD
relics.flavor: Saints, knights, and believers. All of them are madmen. Dear God, even the chalice itself is made of pure gold!

relics.name: King's Crown
relics.effect: When Life Point is at 1, all allied units have +50% ATK, increased to +150% ATK if you have collected 3 or more King's Collectibles
relics.flavor: O Nameless Kings, may you continue to bless Iberia, even though your kingdoms are no more.

relics.name: Cannot's Mark
relics.effect: Gain 1 Hope whenever you buy an item at the Rogue Trader or make an exchange at Lost and Found
relics.flavor: Some are willing to do favors for Cannot to maintain good terms, while others deserve the same treatment from Cannot.
relics.unlock: In the 'Prospective Investment System,' reach an Investment Reserve Balance of 325

relics.name: Roundstone Altar
relics.effect: Chance to permanently increase all allied units' ATK and DEF by 5% after a battle (Stacks up to 10 times)
relics.flavor: An offering made is returned with a reward. So simple it was, that people never questioned what they were sacrificing to.

relics.name: Ancient Tree Fruit
relics.effect: Immediately obtain 3 random trinkets
relics.flavor: The children of Sami make their wishes into tree seeds and bury them in the snow. When the tree bears fruit, the first four are taken, and the smallest is left to the next generation for wish making. The rest are tributes to Sami for hearing their questions.

relics.name: Friston.P
relics.effect: Allied units permanently gain ASPD +5 for every Emergency Ops cleared (Stacks up to 15 times)
relics.flavor: Friston would certainly not miss out on an opportunity to explore the secrets of another predecessor civilization. Oh, but Closure didn't even consider making backups, so DON'T tell her about this!

relics.name: Expeditioner's Field Pack
relics.effect: Operators gain ATK +60% and Resistance for 15 seconds after recovering from a negative status
relics.flavor: They always stuff their backpacks with survival supplies, then press forward with the determination and will to challenge the boundaries of the known.

relics.name: Minoan Ode
relics.effect: Allied units permanently gain HP +5% for every Emergency Ops cleared (Stacks up to 15 times)
relics.flavor: 'Is there a feat more worthy of praise than an expedition into no man's land? Now, yes! Go forth into the north, and write the next chapter of your saga!'

relics.name: Knight Lance Pro
relics.effect: Treasure Chests on the battlefield will drop more Originium Ingots
relics.flavor: Kazimierz Major lottery tickets with hard-to-get adverts for weapons printed on them.

relics.name: Coin-Operated Toy
relics.effect: For each 5 Originium Ingots in possession, all allied units have +3 ASPD
relics.flavor: No idea why anyone would like a design like this, but its overall concept is indeed praiseworthy—Just insert a coin, and even a statue will start moving. There is nothing truer in this world.

relics.name: Chivalric Commandments - New Edition
relics.effect: For each 5 Originium Ingots in possession, all allied units have +5 ASPD
relics.flavor: Taking solemn vows is a thing of the past. The spirit of modern knighthood requires more flexible displays. Go ahead and input your number in the communications device, and you too will be an honorary knight.

relics.name: Secret HR Letter
relics.effect: 6-star Operators cost -2 Hope to recruit, and every recruitment has a chance for all 6-star Operators to appear with a random promotion
relics.flavor: '■■■ gave this to you? Guess there's no problem then.'

relics.name: 'Bridge of Knowledge'
relics.effect: Every Inspirer used grants all allied units +5% HP (Stacks up to 10 times)
relics.flavor: It is said you need only hold it, and its vibrations will lead you to the Liches' Temple of Knowledge. Is that really true? It stays silent. Those who fail to question it will indeed never reach those doors.

relics.name: Mercenary's Accessory
relics.effect: Grants a random Operator +5% ATK, DEF, and Max HP, plus an additional +5% after each perfectly cleared battle (Stacks up to 10 times)
relics.flavor: A small price to pay for pursuing perfection. Small because it hasn't really affected his reading and writing.

relics.name: Children of the Walls
relics.effect: Operators deployed on the 8 tiles surrounding the Objective Point gain +2 Block and +50% Max HP
relics.flavor: The Children of Soil and Stone carefully taught the ancient city of Kazdel how to toughen itself and protect its people behind its walls. With the advent of a protracted peace, it was broken into many little pieces and turned into amulets for adventurers heading into unexplored lands.

relics.name: King's New Lance
relics.effect: When Life Point is 1, all allied units have +50 ASPD
relics.flavor: Beautiful wishes made in dire straits can bring hope, even if they are not necessarily the truth.

relics.name: King's Armor
relics.effect: Shield +3; converts all Life Points into Shield; Life Point -1 and Shield +1 after each battle
relics.flavor: There used to be many golden display cases placed before the palace gates and in the square, displaying all sorts of treasures to admire. But now, it hurts just to think about such sights.

relics.name: King's Legacy
relics.effect: When Life Point is at 1, all Operators recover an additional 1 SP and 3% of Max HP every 2 seconds
relics.flavor: Grow up and face reality. Arm yourself with tenacity and confidence, while showing your friends tolerance and grace.

relics.name: Personal Witchcraft Terminal
relics.effect: All Operators have +35 ASPD if you used an Inspirer as the battle started
relics.flavor: 'We use the name 'Teekaz witchcraft' to honor what our ancestors discovered during the uncivilized parts of our history. But today it has become a discipline permeating all of Terra, and our explorations and developments in this field are far from over.'

relics.name: Primordial Vestige
relics.effect: All Operators DP Cost -6 if you did not use an Inspirer as the battle started
relics.flavor: The most significant change in these animals is the mutation they undergo after contracting Oripathy. Otherwise, their records have remained unchanged for countless years.

relics.name: Disaster's Origin
relics.effect: All enemies take +20% Arts damage and +100% Elemental Injury
relics.flavor: The Sarkaz dug through the Targangils Prime Vein and Originium crystals spurted forth from Kazdel. Their fall was inevitable, so they wanted everything on this great land to be buried together with them.

relics.name: Slave Hunter
relics.effect: Units that become Levitated, Weightless, or are shifted will take 50% more damage for 10 seconds
relics.flavor: After obtaining Nasti's designs, the Sarkaz put them to use in war right away. They flew into the sky, dominating the Ancients with waves of wrath, and the never-ending war entered a new stage.

relics.name: Sarkaz King's Regal Rest
relics.effect: All Operators gain +20% DEF and +10 RES at full Life Points
relics.flavor: For those in this position, a peaceful sleep becomes eternal

relics.name: Sarkaz King's Torn Banner
relics.effect: All Operators gain +30 ASPD at full Life Points
relics.flavor: For those in this position, to struggle is to inevitably fall.

relics.name: Commander's Portrait
relics.effect: All allied units gain +10% ATK and Max HP, and an additional +20% in Dreadful Foe nodes
relics.flavor: The portrait depicts a remarkable individual who made distrustful kings shake hands and soldiers who could not understand each other stand shoulder to shoulder. If she were alive today, Terra's unification might seem surprisingly plausible.

relics.name: Soul Binding Bone
relics.effect: For every Thought you have, all Operators gain +3% ATK
relics.flavor: The elder revenant made a cage with his own bones to seal his kin within, and then tracked down his revenant kin scattered across the land in this tattered husk.

relics.name: Soul Furnace's Fuel
relics.effect: For every Thought you have, all Operators gain +5% ATK
relics.flavor: The bones were thrown into the furnace, sending flames bursting forth. The revenants entangle into each other, transforming all their lament, fury, serenity, and shame into the energy that keeps Kazdel moving.

relics.name: Survivor Contract
relics.effect: At the start of battle, a random Operator gains +20% ATK and DEF, plus an additional +20% at the end of each battle
relics.flavor: A very long contract, in which every term and condition is the result of experience, leaving no room for chance or sentiment. Satisfy them all to be the final survivor.

relics.name: Masterless Memories
relics.effect: Immediately obtain 5 Thoughts at most left behind from your last adventure
relics.flavor: As the elder tossed them into the furnace, some revenants finally remembered where they came from and their duties, and remade their oaths to their faith. Others unleashed a sudden slew of curses, magnifying the echoes of flames reverberating on the furnace walls.

relics.name: Herr Hraaselsuher
relics.effect: Toil Limit +2 and chance to gain 1 Plan after combat
relics.flavor: Albrecht Von Musbeast, Graf of the Spire of Rosen und Horns, is at your service, pledging to bring you lost treasures and hidden wisdom! He asks only for an occasional share of the haul, saying they're for his wife and daughter.

relics.name: 'Song to Make A Tenacious Mind'
relics.effect: Every Inspirer used grants +1 Shield
relics.flavor: The song tells of a Djall born with the ability to sense fear. She was candid with what she sensed, but everyone was still wary. She later honed her skills to defeat foes without this power, yet remained known as the 'Arch-liar'.

relics.name: Anchor For Five Seconds Ago
relics.effect: Gain 1 extra Inspirer after the battle if you used an Inspirer as the battle started
relics.flavor: A young Lich was fretting over occasionally forgetting an idea he thought of five seconds ago, so he created this anchor to set those fleeting inspirations in place. Afterwards, he seemed to have forgotten to use it.

relics.name: Personal Paintbrush
relics.effect: Plans have -1 Toil
relics.flavor: A haunted brush that compels its owners to paint with their own blood. The masterpiece mesmerizes beholders into adding another stroke the same way. Eventually, the elder revenant found the brush, along with many paintings, and sealed the rogue revenant in his bones.

relics.name: Scales of Avarice
relics.effect: Gain +3 Originium Ingots for each non-combat node entered when Total Mental Toil exceeds 20
relics.flavor: Merchants offered money, treasure, and even their lives and souls, but couldn't balance the scales to obtain the feather-light glow. The elder revenant crushed the scales with his soul and sealed the rogue revenant in his bones.

relics.name: Word-Carving Knife
relics.effect: <Spines of Epoch> and <Spikes of Weeping> have -50% DEF
relics.flavor: Once the standard tool of Sarkaz stonemasons. It is said carving prayers on weeping spikes can calm the revenants' resentment. The knife is still sharp, but no one remembers the prayers.

relics.name: Thoughts Catcher
relics.effect: Originium Ingot +1 after each interpretation
relics.flavor: Sorting truth from falsehood takes time, and some ideas will invariably scatter. In such moments, professionally trained retainers will snatch those ideas up and turn them into true wealth.
relics.unlock: Consolidate 'False to Truth' nodes 4 times in Impression Restoration

relics.name: Doodle of Hope
relics.effect: Hope +3; Emergency Ops will no longer appear when refreshing nodes; triggers wondrous effects in Encounter nodes
relics.flavor: 'I'm a Teekaz orphan. My parents died in a Catastrophe, and it was my Feline neighbor who raised me and treated me as one of his own. I can say with a clear conscience that I am a descendant of the Ancients.'

relics.name: Talons of Hatred
relics.effect: All allied units and enemies have +20% ATK; Emergency Ops will appear more often when refreshing nodes; triggers wondrous effects in Encounter nodes
relics.flavor: 'A vampire killed my sister, a Nachzehrer took my papa, and mama escaped with me. I'll never compromise with the Sarkaz. They can repent when they're all gone.'

relics.name: Burdenherd Bell
relics.effect: Burdenbeast Traveler joins your squad; gains an additional choice when loot drops from a Wish Fulfilled node
relics.flavor: Whip it, and it will flee in terror; Pull on the reins, and it will resist. Ring the bell, hum a tune, and it will follow you to the ends of the land.

relics.name: Lamp of Wishes
relics.effect: Originium Ingots +10, Wish Fulfilled will appear more often when refreshing nodes; triggers wondrous effects in Wish Fulfilled
relics.flavor: 'I heard the Sarkaz can grant any wish, so I dug deep to find their secrets. It seems this was the start of their suffering.'

relics.name: Rolling Ancestors
relics.effect: All enemy units have ASPD +30, Movement Speed +30%, and Max HP +30%; can encounter a different Dreadful Foe in Border of Truth
relics.flavor: Oh great, the ancestors are here, and they want something more exciting...

relics.name: Blood Tax Mystery
relics.effect: All allied and enemy units have -35% Max HP; only active in Bizarre Fragments
relics.flavor: 'Duq'arael ultimately failed. He stepped forward bravely, but did not manage to stop his brother Danso. The deep red chains then tethered all life on this land, so we now leave a trail of blood with every step we take. This blood tax is to repay the baseless debt we owe.'

relics.name: Crystal Mystery
relics.effect: All low ground Operators have +600 DEF but are Frozen for 15 seconds after deployment; only active in Bizarre Fragments
relics.flavor: 'The Rotproofers' descendants, called 'Ice Gargoyles,' complemented the Diαblos with their icy powers and cool heads, skillfully covering each other's flaws. But they were deceived by Kalnawdika and never resurfaced after going underground to stop the Black Flow.'

relics.name: Suspicion Mystery
relics.effect: Earn double the Originium Ingots post battle, but also lose double the Life Points; only active in Bizarre Fragments
relics.flavor: 'Duq'hraqaam openly questioned the Farchaser's caution towards the ruins and led his descendants underground. Prophecy foretold his demise by an 'ancient wound that refuses to heal' and that his descendants would call themselves 'Durin.' Their test tunnels would reach deep into the land's core, but no living soul would ever see them again.'

relics.name: Fabrication Mystery
relics.effect: Starting DP +50, but natural DP regeneration rate is reduced by 50%; only active in Bizarre Fragments
relics.flavor: The 'Great Deceiver' once visited this Place of Possibility. She enriched the scenery with vivid tales, invited Sarkaz to hear ancient stories, and left puzzles revealing historical insights if solved. Yet, people insisted the Djall Arch-liar spoke only lies, leaving the Sarkaz convinced that what they heard was mere fabrications.

relics.name: Foresight Mystery
relics.effect: Gain +20% Command EXP from battles, extra enemies will appear in battle; only active in Bizarre Fragments
relics.flavor: 'Lone eye, self-gouged; exile, a favor from the Liches. Mur'rannag endured this to prevent a future seen in visions. Since then, newborn Cyclopes started having two eyes like regular Sarkaz, but the prophecy was documented and would still come true.'

relics.name: Sigil Mystery
relics.effect: All Operators gain +30 Starting SP, but natural SP recovery rate is reduced by 50%; only active in Bizarre Fragments
relics.flavor: 'With the sovereign's approval, the Northwind Witch Qalaiša taught the Nachzehrers how to draw energy from the Eternal Hunt's rigid laws. To Nezzsalem, that was the start of his subjects surpassing nature with reason. His decision exceeded everyone's expectations, and the Nachzehrers continue to revere him as their liege after becoming Nachzehrer Beschützers.'

relics.name: Tranquil Mystery
relics.effect: All allied and enemy units have -25% ATK, only effective in Bizarre Fragments
relics.flavor: 'From the peak of Mount Anius to the heart of Lake Hyperion sit numerous monasteries of 'those without roots'. They work when their bells ring and rest otherwise. These bells seem to originate from the source of all things, and their rings resonate through eternity, beckoning all those seeking westward to turn back and ordering those sweeping eastward to lay down their arms. And thus, the nations of Victoria and Kazdel have enjoyed peace that lasts to this day.'

relics.name: Silk Bond Mystery
relics.effect: Operators take continuous damage if other Operators are within the 8 surrounding tiles; otherwise, gain +50 ASPD; only active in Bizarre Fragments
relics.flavor: 'Lich Bertha was obsessed with other kinds of Sarkaz since childhood. On the very next day that she became a 'First Scribe', she forced a witchcraft contract with a test subject animal to unlock its intelligence, creating the 'Slugkaz'. Her silk threads remain hidden, afraid to face the other Liches.'

relics.name: Pledge of Babel
relics.effect: All Operators +3 DP Cost; leads expedition in a different direction
relics.flavor: 'Babel' is directly led by two Kings of Sarkaz who have contributed greatly to the advancement of the military, technology, and medicine. Its initial, and also ultimate, goal is to eliminate war itself by any means necessary.
relics.unlock: Complete an adventure

relics.name: Prophet Horn
relics.effect: Nodes will turn into Prophecy when refreshed; not active in Bizarre Fragments
relics.flavor: It was neither guns nor blades that conquered the Elders and Ancients, but the Law. Soon, the significance of the word 'teekaz' transcended race, and Kazdel became home to all life.
relics.unlock: Complete an adventure

relics.name: Ten Rings
relics.effect: Shadows of the Lord -50% Max HP
relics.flavor: Amiya hoped to change the land with her own power rather than relying on the King of Sarkaz. She refused their kindness and journeyed through Terra's nations with unmatched resilience and resolution, saving lives and calling for peace until Oripathy claimed her life.

relics.name: Time and Light
relics.effect: Epochs will occur more often, and Thoughts have +1 Toil; leads expedition in a different direction
relics.flavor: The first mad howl that awakened the Law.

relics.name: Petal
relics.effect: -50% Command EXP and Originium Ingots from battles; triggers wondrous effects in Face-Off
relics.flavor: Epiphany.
relics.unlock: Complete an adventure after [Expansion I]

relics.name: Anasa's Karma
relics.effect: Leader and Elite enemies have +50% max HP; Dreadful Foes in Border of Truth will be more difficult; leads expedition in a different direction
relics.flavor: His nature has changed and his sword lies shattered, yet the crystals on his body are an eternal reminder that his spirit still needs honing.
relics.unlock: Complete an adventure after [Expansion I]

relics.name: Prophetic Image
relics.effect: Finale Cadence will appear in battles
relics.flavor: You must have heard this before: 'I see you, black crown on your head, melting millions of lives, into nothing but memories.'
relics.unlock: Reach the ending once after [Expansion II]

relics.name: Endless Key
relics.effect: Leads expedition in a different direction
relics.flavor: Through your torrent of inspirations, a story takes shape from nothingness. Through your exhausted imagination, Amiya will put an end to everything. Can your thoughts become a weapon to resist her?
relics.unlock: Reach the ending once after [Expansion II]

relics.name: Framework of The End
relics.effect: All Operators have +2 DP Cost; all enemies take 20% less Physical and Arts damage
relics.flavor: Catastrophes and war, as far as the eye can see. When help cannot stop death, when medical treatment becomes only an accomplice to hatred, Amiya carries on with the only option left: the futile, mechanical act of 'saving lives'.
relics.unlock: Reach the ending once after [Expansion II]

relics.name: Body of The End
relics.effect: All Operators have +2 DP Cost; all enemies take 20% less Physical and Arts damage and gain 20% ATK
relics.flavor: Amiya looks sadly at the person before her, sealed within the 'cocoon'. Frozen in place, they will no longer feel pain, nor will Originium cut their life short. She was unwilling to recklessly use her newly awakened powers, but now... there is no other choice.
relics.unlock: Reach the ending once after [Expansion II]

relics.name: Reality of The End
relics.effect: All Operators have +2 DP Cost; all enemies take 20% less Physical and Arts damage and gain 20% ATK; extra enemies will appear in the last battle
relics.flavor: Everything has been sealed into the 'cocoon', and now time flows only for Amiya. She will seek a panacea for all afflictions—physical or mental, she wants to cure them all. An absolutely lonely and endlessly long journey stands before her. She has already set off.
relics.unlock: Reach the ending once after [Expansion II]

relics.name: 'Glory Pack'
relics.effect: When an allied unit is defeated, all enemies in the four adjacent tiles are stunned for 6 seconds
relics.flavor: A special betting method set up by the organizers for the knight competition season. Diversify your bets with various plans to minimize losses on any match.

relics.name: Rainbow Jar
relics.effect: Whenever an enemy enters the Objective Point, the Redeployment Time of a random Operator waiting to be re-deployed is reduced to 0
relics.flavor: Usually placed by the Sami people where rainbows fall then carefully preserved, it is used to ward off unpredictable catastrophes, both natural and man-made.

relics.name: 'Devilbane Banner'
relics.effect: Operators recover 2 SP when dealing damage to [Sarkaz] enemies
relics.flavor: Made by Sarkaz mercenaries loyal to Iberia, and used to kill Sarkaz mercenaries loyal to Leithanien. Many years later, Sarkaz mercenaries loyal to Victoria picked it up and gave it its name.
relics.unlock: Across multiple adventures, defeat the Leader 'Kal'tsit' 2 times

relics.name: Holy City's Embrace
relics.effect: Takes 35% less damage from [Sarkaz] enemies
relics.flavor: 'O holy Kazdel! May you bless my bullets as you have blessed our eternal covenant; may you bridge my gun to my target just as you have bridged the Sankta and the Sarkaz!'

relics.name: 'Little Cube'
relics.effect: All Allied units gain +10% Max HP, and an additional +80% in Face-Off nodes
relics.flavor: The Liches' vessel, capable of transcending time and space, proves even more durable in fantasies. Ermengarde spent a lot of time fixing it up.

relics.name: Great Banshee's Veil
relics.effect: All enemies take +10% Arts damage and +50% Elemental Injury
relics.flavor: The former Lord of the Banshees always seemed amicable, as if that were her only side... until she pulled out her bone pen, sang softly, and impaled agonizing wails into the minds of every intruder.
relics.unlock: Across multiple adventures, defeat the Leader 'Laqeramaline' 2 times

relics.name: Fearless Blade
relics.effect: When the battle begins, the Operator with the highest DP Cost gains +50% ATK and DEF
relics.flavor: Before Kazdel's gates he stood, an impregnable bulwark. Gaulish artilleries, Leithanian casters, and Victorian Knights all took their shots at him. Yet, even when the gates fell and the coalition retreated, the Goliath did not yield an inch.
relics.unlock: Across multiple adventures, defeat the Leader 'Goliath' 2 times

relics.name: Arch Glyph
relics.effect: For one time only, if you would fail any battle other than the final battle of the area or a Leader battle and are currently not in a Bizarre Fragment, you will enter a special Bizarre Fragment
relics.flavor: Since antiquity, Kazdel has been concealed within the northern wind and snow. Led by the Cyclopes, the Sarkaz jointly created this Foldartal seal with their psychic powers. In a pinch, place it on ice and snow to hide within the Feranmut beneath your feet, evading the 'enemy'.

relics.name: 'Civilight Eterna'
relics.effect: All enemies take +150% True damage
relics.flavor: A small, black crown.

relics.name: 'Little Gran Faro'
relics.effect: Stuns all enemy units for 5 seconds every time an enemy unit enters the Objective Point
relics.flavor: An illumination device reverse-engineered from the Eye of Iberia. It can penetrate thick, dark clouds and temporarily repel powerful enemies.
relics.unlock: Across multiple adventures, lose a total of 125 Objective Life Points

relics.name: 'Memories of The Shard'
relics.effect: Deals 5000 True damage to all enemy units every time an enemy unit enters the Objective Point
relics.flavor: 'Still impaled on Victoria's heart, it watches as the empire bleeds.'

relics.name: HR Bronze Seal
relics.effect: Recruit a random 5-star Operator that is automatically Promoted
relics.flavor: Emblem assigned to specific Operators when ■■■ receives an emergency deployment command. Your receipt of it signifies that ■■■ has completed the assignment.

relics.name: Doctor Silver Seal
relics.effect: Recruit a random 6-star Operator that is automatically Promoted
relics.flavor: Emblem that you instructed to be sent out at the right time before you left. Your selected Operator has joined the field mission at the camp, while handing it back to you the way you left it.
relics.unlock: Reach a Squad Size Limit of 13 at any point

relics.name: Gul'dul's Silence
relics.effect: All enemies gain +3000 DEF, but lose 100 DEF upon taking damage (Stacks up to 30 times)
relics.flavor: He stood at Kazdel's highest point and turned to stone. The Elder Hegemons retreated upon witnessing his black crown, while the Sarkaz rejoiced. This spectacle they named 'King of Sarkaz' endured for a long time—until the day the Sarkaz forgot their King, and pushed the statue down with their own hands.

relics.name: Qui'sartuštaj's Promise
relics.effect: All 5-star and above Operators cost +1 Hope to recruit and promote
relics.flavor: With every changing generation, he promised his people and his carriers he would change the status quo for the Sarkaz. Within the layers of amassed hope and trust, he placed the crown on the ring-shaped structure, and knocked on the gates to the starry sky.

relics.name: Balor'sača's Arrogance
relics.effect: Elite and Leader enemies gain +20% HP, DEF, and ATK
relics.flavor: Lava obediently followed Balor'sača's army and spread across the land. They cared not for the Elder Hegemons, nor for their fellow Sarkaz. This land belongs to the Diαblo, and there is no need for others. As their King, Balor'sača absolutely cannot allow the crown to fall on the head of another.

relics.name: Yliš's Ravings
relics.effect: All Operators start with -20 SP
relics.flavor: Alas, the poor man. He could not comprehend the crown's power, and became a puppet. He was no longer his humble self, and lost the will to speak his own words. He became the first sacrifice to the crown's awakening.

relics.name: Shard of the Untold Kings
relics.effect: Loadbearing Operators have -30% ATK
relics.flavor: A guardian of the Temple of Knowledge uses their phylactery to unveil the mysteries of life, a crazy Sarkaz mercenary saddles a revenant to sow chaos, a vexing Beast Aristocrat establishes a commercial empire with the furnace, an ancient Feline wears the crown and subdues her own creator... Many stories remain folded within thoughts, waiting to be told.

relics.name: Judgement: Guard
relics.effect: For every Bizarre Fragment Collectible owned, Guard Operators gain +20% ATK and +20 ASPD
relics.flavor: Faced with the revenants' myriad mysteries, the Guards brandish their weapons and cut a path.

relics.name: Judgement: Vanguard
relics.effect: For every Bizarre Fragment Collectible owned, Vanguard Operators gain +20% ATK and +30% Max HP
relics.flavor: Faced with the revenants' myriad mysteries, the Vanguards take the lead and charge in.

relics.name: Judgement: Defender
relics.effect: For every Bizarre Fragment Collectible owned, Defender Operators gain +20% DEF and +30% Max HP
relics.flavor: Faced with the revenants' myriad mysteries, the Defenders prepare their defenses and steadily advance.

relics.name: Judgement: Sniper
relics.effect: For every Bizarre Fragment Collectible owned, Sniper Operators gain +20% ATK and +20 ASPD
relics.flavor: Faced with the revenants' myriad mysteries, the Snipers adjust positions and unleash their firepower.

relics.name: Judgement: Specialist
relics.effect: For every Bizarre Fragment Collectible owned, Specialist Operators gain +20% ATK and +30% Max HP
relics.flavor: Faced with the revenants' myriad mysteries, the Specialists swiftly drop in on key targets.

relics.name: Judgement: Medic
relics.effect: For every Bizarre Fragment Collectible owned, Medic Operators gain +50% ATK
relics.flavor: Faced with the revenants' myriad mysteries, the Medics treat the wounded and wait for the tides to shift.

relics.name: Judgement: Caster
relics.effect: For every Bizarre Fragment Collectible owned, Caster Operators gain +20% ATK and +20 ASPD
relics.flavor: Faced with the revenants' myriad mysteries, the Casters release their Arts to deconstruct them.

relics.name: Judgement: Supporter
relics.effect: For every Bizarre Fragment Collectible owned, Supporter Operators gain +50% ATK
relics.flavor: Faced with the revenants' myriad mysteries, the Supporters break the mold and offer their unique ingenuity.

relics.name: Hand of Fireworks
relics.effect: Marksman, Loopshooter, and Sentry Protector Operators have a 25% chance on each attack to shoot an extra projectile, dealing 200% ATK as AoE Physical Damage
relics.flavor: Bang! Boom! A pleasant surprise.

relics.name: Clotheskaz
relics.effect: Operators immediately obtain 30 SP after their skill ends for the first time
relics.flavor: The Clotheskaz community thrives on the fierce competition among the creatures that wear them.

relics.name: Unripe Yearning
relics.effect: For every Thought you have, all Operators gain +3% Max HP and DEF
relics.flavor: These incomplete thoughts cling to their creators, zealously guarding them until they obtain their forms through a sudden revelation and embark on a long journey.

relics.name: Cursed Counterbeast
relics.effect: All Operators gain +5 ASPD; consumes 1 Inspirer after each battle to grant an additional 5 ASPD (stacks up to 10 times)
relics.flavor: These bizarre beasts, born of falsehood, are drawn to fleeting flashes of odd thoughts. They devour wantonly, and when time shatters and paradoxes surge, they give birth to new cubs.
relics.unlock: Across multiple adventures, clear a total of 30 battles after [Expansion II]

relics.name: 'Blossom'
relics.effect: All Operators recover 1 SP every time they take damage or Elemental Injury
relics.flavor: After several attempts by Touch, nature briefly opens up to you.
relics.unlock: Across multiple adventures, obtain a total of 75 Collectibles after [Expansion II]

relics.name: Surging Feast
relics.effect: All allied units receive +30% healing effectiveness and take -30% Elemental Injury
relics.flavor: We've known how to indulge since birth. Do not resist your desires. Submit to them instead.

relics.name: Rhoder's Gate
relics.effect: Immediately recruit multiple Reserve Operators; at the end of each combat, the last deployed Operator will be sent to a Scout node
relics.flavor: This remodeled Portal binds two stories together, with the other end being Rhozdel—a safe haven for both Sarkaz and Infected.

relics.name: Visage of Crowned Fates
relics.effect: Shield +3; converts all remaining max Life Points into an equivalent amount of Shield before reducing max Life Points to 1
relics.flavor: Each King bears a unique fate and form.

relics.name: King of Sarkaz's Vessel
relics.effect: All Operators gain +80% Max HP when Life Points are full, increased to 200% if you have collected 3 or more King of Sarkaz's Collectibles
relics.flavor: For those in this position, prosperity is but an illusion.

relics.name: Expunger of Hatred
relics.effect: +5 Mental Toil; if Deathmatch is used in a perfect clear, obtain a Deathmatch after the battle
relics.flavor: This weapon was forged by those unwilling to be blinded by hatred. It reveals a path: When the fear born of violence overpowers all hatred, then maybe, there exists a glimpse of the first light of peace.

relics.name: Baby Djall
relics.effect: +3 Hope, obtain an extra +8 Hope when this Collectible is exchanged in Lost and Found
relics.flavor: 'Oh, my little cutie-pie! Enough tickling my head, alright?'
relics.unlock: Across multiple adventures, earn a total of 50 Hope after [Expansion II]

relics.name: Eye of Fortune
relics.effect: Originium Ingots +5, Operators dispatched in Scout nodes will return with 5 extra Ingots
relics.flavor: A millennium after the Sarkaz vanished, the saying 'the eye of a Cyclops opens for wealth' became folklore. People began worshipping discs with a single embedded eye, seeking wealth and happiness.
relics.unlock: Across all adventures, earn a total of 150 Originium Ingots after [Expansion II]

relics.name: Wondrous Graffiti
relics.effect: Whenever an enemy enters the Objective Point, all Operators on field gain 20 SP
relics.flavor: The Liches often add a few more strokes to these pieces of 'street art'. According to them, it is mostly an economical way to bolster the city streets' defenses.
relics.unlock: Across multiple adventures, lose a total of 25 Life Points after [Expansion II]
